extra_vocab.en: a person whose job is to make or repair things made of wood
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於裝修、辦公室修繕與工程情境，例如請木工做櫃子、修門或地板。

example.en: Two carpenters are fixing the wooden floor in the lobby.
example.zh: 兩位木工正在修大廳的木地板。

example.en: We need to hire a carpenter before the store opens.
example.zh: 商店開張前，我們需要僱一位木工。

example.en: A skilled carpenter made the tables for our new restaurant.
example.zh: 一位技術純熟的木工替我們的新餐廳做了桌子。

example.en: He worked as a carpenter before he started his own company.
example.zh: 他創業前是做木工的。

examples.en: The carpenter will build new shelves for our storage room.
examples.zh: 木工會替我們的儲藏室做新的架子。

examples.en: We asked a carpenter to repair the broken office door.
examples.zh: 我們請木工修理辦公室壞掉的門。

examples.en: Our company is looking for an experienced carpenter this spring.
examples.zh: 我們公司今年春天在找有經驗的木工。

confusable.diff: carpet 是「地毯」，拼法開頭和 carpenter 很像，但和木工無關。

example.en: The workers will put a new carpet in the meeting room.
example.zh: 工人會在會議室鋪新地毯。

similar.diff: builder 指蓋房子的人，範圍較廣；carpenter 專指做木工的人。

example.en: The builder finished the new office building two weeks early.
example.zh: 建築商提早兩週完成了新辦公大樓。

example.en: The plumber fixed the leak in the kitchen this morning.
example.zh: 水管工今天早上修好了廚房的漏水。

example.en: An electrician will check the lights in the hall today.
example.zh: 電工今天會檢查大廳的燈。

example.en: The painter will start work on the walls on Monday.
example.zh: 油漆工星期一會開始粉刷牆壁。

example.en: The contractor sent us a cost estimate by email yesterday.
example.zh: 承包商昨天用電子郵件寄給我們費用估價。

derived.link: carpenter 的 -er 換成 -ry，變成這個行業或手藝，像 jewel → jewelry

extra_vocab.en: a person or company that provides food and drink for events
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司聚餐、會議午餐、開幕活動等情境，通常要提前聯絡、確認人數與菜單。

example.en: Several caterers sent us price quotes for the staff party.
example.zh: 好幾家外燴業者寄給我們員工聚會的報價。

example.en: A local caterer provided food for the opening ceremony.
example.zh: 一家當地的外燴業者為開幕典禮提供餐點。

example.en: Please contact the caterer to confirm the number of guests.
example.zh: 請聯絡外燴業者確認賓客人數。

example.en: We should book a caterer at least two weeks early.
example.zh: 我們至少應該提前兩週預約外燴業者。

examples.en: We hired a caterer for the company dinner next Friday.
examples.zh: 我們請了外燴業者負責下星期五的公司晚宴。

examples.en: Please ask the caterer to send us a menu by Monday.
examples.zh: 請要求外燴業者星期一前把菜單寄給我們。

examples.en: The caterer will deliver lunch to the conference room at noon.
examples.zh: 外燴業者中午會把午餐送到會議室。

similar.diff: 意思相同，catering company 強調是一家公司；caterer 可指公司也可指個人。

example.en: The catering company offers lunch boxes for large meetings.
example.zh: 這家餐飲公司提供大型會議用的便當。

example.en: The annual banquet will be held in the grand ballroom.
example.zh: 年度宴會將在大宴會廳舉行。

example.en: The hotel serves a hot buffet breakfast every morning.
example.zh: 飯店每天早上供應熱的自助早餐。

example.en: The venue can hold about two hundred guests.
example.zh: 這個場地可以容納大約兩百位賓客。

example.en: Please check the menu for guests who cannot eat meat.
example.zh: 請檢查菜單，看有沒有適合不吃肉的賓客。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。caterer = cater + -er，做這件事的人，像 teacher、worker
cater + -ing，把「提供餐飲」這件事變成名詞，像 meeting、marketing

extra_vocab.en: a small container of ink or toner that you put in a printer
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見於辦公室情境，印表機沒墨水或沒碳粉時要更換 cartridge，也常出現在採購與辦公用品訂單裡。

example.en: The store sells printer cartridges at a lower price online.
example.zh: 這家店在網路上以較低的價格賣印表機墨水匣。

example.en: This ink cartridge fits most office printers made by our supplier.
example.zh: 這個墨水匣適用我們供應商製造的大部分辦公室印表機。

example.en: Each toner cartridge can print about two thousand pages.
example.zh: 每個碳粉匣大約可以印兩千頁。

example.en: It takes only a minute to replace a cartridge.
example.zh: 更換一個墨水匣只要一分鐘。

examples.en: The printer stopped because the cartridge was empty.
examples.zh: 印表機停了，因為墨水匣空了。

examples.en: Please order five new cartridges for the second floor.
examples.zh: 請為二樓訂五個新的墨水匣。

examples.en: The cartridge you ordered will arrive on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 你訂的墨水匣星期三會送到。

confusable.diff: carriage 是「（火車）車廂」或「馬車」，拼法和 cartridge 都有 car-，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The train has one first-class carriage at the front.
example.zh: 這班火車最前面有一節頭等車廂。

example.en: Please keep spare toner in the supply closet.
example.zh: 請把備用碳粉放在置物櫃裡。

example.en: The printer on the second floor is out of order.
example.zh: 二樓的印表機故障了。

example.en: You can buy an ink refill instead of a new cartridge.
example.zh: 你可以買墨水補充包，不用買新的墨水匣。

example.en: The office supplies arrive on the first Monday of each month.
example.zh: 辦公用品每個月第一個星期一送到。

extra_vocab.en: an official paper or process that shows you have the skills or quality needed
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於求職、專業訓練與產品品質情境，例如應徵時要附上 certification，或工廠通過品質認證。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「認證這件事」時常當不可數名詞（obtain certification），指「一張證書」或「一項資格」時可數（two certifications）。

example.en: Our staff hold several certifications in safety and first aid.
example.zh: 我們的員工持有數項安全與急救的證書。

example.en: Workers must obtain certification before they use the machine.
example.zh: 工人使用這台機器前必須取得認證。

example.en: A professional certification can help you get a better job.
example.zh: 專業認證可以幫你找到更好的工作。

example.en: The new heater passed the safety certification test last week.
example.zh: 這款新暖氣機上星期通過了安全認證測試。

example.en: She is studying hard for the certification exam in June.
example.zh: 她正為六月的認證考試用功準備。

examples.en: Candidates need a teaching certification to apply for this job.
examples.zh: 應徵者需要教師資格證書才能申請這份工作。

examples.en: The factory received international quality certification last year after an inspection.
examples.zh: 這間工廠去年經過檢查後取得了國際品質認證。

examples.en: Please send a copy of your certification with your application.
examples.zh: 請隨申請文件附上你的證書影本。

confusable.diff: certificate 是一張紙本證書；certification 強調取得認證的過程或資格。
confusable.usage: certificate 是可數的實體文件（a certificate），certification 指認證這件事時多為不可數。

example.en: Each participant will receive a certificate at the end of the course.
example.zh: 每位參加者在課程結束時會拿到一張證書。

example.en: You need a license to operate this type of machine.
example.zh: 操作這種機器需要執照。

example.en: Applicants must have a high school diploma or higher.
example.zh: 應徵者必須有高中以上的畢業證書。

example.en: Her qualifications make her perfect for the manager position.
example.zh: 她的資歷讓她很適合經理一職。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。-fy 是「使成為」的動詞字尾，像 simplify、identify
certify 的 -fy 換成 -ficate，指證明的那張紙，像 duplicate

senses.en: the process of getting official approval that you have the needed skills

example.en: Certification takes about three months and includes a written test.
example.zh: 取得認證大約要三個月，還包含一場筆試。

senses.en: an official paper that shows you passed a test or met a standard
senses.distinguish: 句中有 copy、attach、show 這類字時，通常是指證書這份文件。

example.en: Please show your certification at the entrance of the lab.
example.zh: 請在實驗室入口出示你的證書。

extra_vocab.en: a show with people and animals that perform in a big tent
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於活動、廣告與休閒情境，例如馬戲團來城市表演、贈送馬戲團門票給客戶。

example.en: Few circuses travel between cities by train today.
example.zh: 現在很少有馬戲團搭火車在城市之間移動。

example.en: The circus tent can seat more than one thousand people.
example.zh: 這個馬戲團帳篷可以容納超過一千人。

example.en: Every circus performer practices for several hours each day.
example.zh: 每位馬戲團表演者每天都練習好幾個小時。

example.en: The bank gave circus tickets to families who opened accounts.
example.zh: 銀行把馬戲團門票送給開戶的家庭。

examples.en: The circus will perform in our city for two weeks.
examples.zh: 馬戲團將在我們城市表演兩週。

examples.en: We gave away circus tickets to our best customers.
examples.zh: 我們把馬戲團門票送給最好的客戶。

examples.en: Many families visit the circus during the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在暑假期間去看馬戲團。

confusable.diff: circuit 是「電路」或「一圈、巡迴」，拼法和 circus 很像，但和表演無關。

example.en: A broken circuit stopped the machine in the factory.
example.zh: 一個壞掉的電路讓工廠的機器停了。

example.en: The town holds a carnival every year in July.
example.zh: 這個城鎮每年七月舉辦嘉年華。

example.en: The music festival attracts visitors from many countries.
example.zh: 這場音樂節吸引了來自許多國家的遊客。

example.en: The evening performance starts at seven thirty.
example.zh: 晚場表演七點半開始。

example.en: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the show.
example.zh: 表演結束時，觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

extra_vocab.en: a person who is in the same class as you at school
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於人脈、求職推薦與社交情境，例如在展覽遇到老同學，或同學推薦工作機會。

example.en: My classmates and I plan to meet after the course ends.
example.zh: 課程結束後，我和同學們打算見個面。

example.en: A former classmate now works in our sales department.
example.zh: 一位以前的同學現在在我們的業務部門工作。

example.en: Peter invited a classmate from college to the product launch.
example.zh: 彼得邀請了一位大學同學參加新產品發表會。

example.en: Studying with a classmate helped me pass the exam.
example.zh: 和同學一起讀書幫助我通過了考試。

examples.en: I met a former classmate at the trade show yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在貿易展遇到一位以前的同學。

examples.en: My classmate recommended me for a job at his company.
examples.zh: 我的同學推薦我到他的公司工作。

examples.en: She studied marketing with a classmate from university.
examples.zh: 她和一位大學同學一起讀行銷。

confusable.diff: colleague 是「同事」，在同一個公司或領域工作；classmate 是在學校的同學。

example.en: My colleague will join the meeting from the Tokyo office.
example.zh: 我的同事會從東京辦公室加入會議。

similar.diff: schoolmate 指同一所學校的人，不一定同班；classmate 指同一個班級的人。

example.en: A schoolmate told me about the open position at the bank.
example.zh: 一位校友告訴我銀行有職缺。

example.en: My coworker showed me how to use the new system.
example.zh: 我的同事教我怎麼用新系統。

example.en: Each teammate is responsible for one part of the project.
example.zh: 每位團隊夥伴負責專案的一個部分。

example.en: My roommate works at a bank near the station.
example.zh: 我的室友在車站附近的銀行工作。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。classmate = class（班級）+ mate（夥伴），同班的夥伴，像 teammate、roommate
class + room（房間），上課的房間，像 bedroom、meeting room

extra_vocab.en: the act of closing a place, road, or business
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公告與新聞情境，例如道路封閉、商店暫時歇業、工廠關廠，常搭配 temporary、due to 等字。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用 closure of + 地點或事業，也可說 due to the closure of ...（因為…關閉）。

example.en: Several school closures were announced because of the storm.
example.zh: 因為暴風雨，宣布了好幾所學校停課。

example.en: A road closure is causing long delays near the airport.
example.zh: 機場附近的道路封閉造成嚴重延誤。

example.en: Customers were upset about the store closure in downtown.
example.zh: 客人對市中心的商店歇業感到不滿。

example.en: The temporary closure will help us finish the repair work.
example.zh: 暫時關閉能讓我們完成維修工作。

examples.en: The closure of the main road will last three days.
examples.zh: 主要道路的封閉將持續三天。

examples.en: The company announced the closure of its old factory.
examples.zh: 公司宣布關閉舊工廠。

examples.en: We apologize for the closure of our store on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們為星期一商店關閉一事致歉。

confusable.diff: closer 是 close 的比較級「更近的」，發音是 /ˈkloʊsər/；closure 是名詞「關閉」。
confusable.usage: closure 是名詞，closer 是形容詞或副詞的比較級（closer to ...）。

example.en: Our new office is closer to the station than the old one.
example.zh: 我們的新辦公室比舊的更靠近車站。

confusable.diff: disclosure 是「揭露、公開」資訊，多用於財務與法律文件，和關閉無關。

example.en: The report requires full disclosure of all costs.
example.zh: 這份報告要求完整揭露所有費用。

similar.diff: shutdown 常指機器、系統或工廠整個停止運作；closure 範圍更廣，也可指道路或商店。

example.en: The shutdown of the system lasted about two hours.
example.zh: 系統關機持續了大約兩個小時。

example.en: The suspension of the service will start on Friday.
example.zh: 服務暫停將從星期五開始。

example.en: We received a cancellation notice from the hotel this morning.
example.zh: 我們今天早上收到飯店的取消通知。

example.en: The delay in delivery was caused by bad weather.
example.zh: 送貨延誤是因為天氣不好。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。closure = close + -ure，把「關閉」變成名詞，像 expose → exposure
en-（放進去）+ close，把東西封在信封裡，像 enter、encourage
enclose + -ure，隨信附上的東西，像 closure

extra_vocab.en: a person who travels to work every day, often from far away
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於交通、公告與廣告情境，例如通勤列車、尖峰時段、為通勤族增加班次。

example.en: Many commuters now work from home two days a week.
example.zh: 許多通勤族現在每週有兩天在家工作。

example.en: A daily commuter can save money with a monthly pass.
example.zh: 每天通勤的人用月票可以省錢。

example.en: The commuter train to the city leaves every ten minutes.
example.zh: 往市區的通勤列車每十分鐘一班。

example.en: Commuter traffic is heaviest between seven and nine in the morning.
example.zh: 通勤車潮在早上七點到九點之間最多。

examples.en: Thousands of commuters take this train every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上有數千名通勤者搭這班火車。

examples.en: The city added more buses to help commuters.
examples.zh: 市政府增加了更多公車來幫助通勤者。

examples.en: This app shows commuters the fastest way to work.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式會告訴通勤者上班最快的路線。

confusable.diff: computer 是「電腦」，拼法和 commuter 只差一兩個字母，閱讀時很容易看錯。

example.en: I use my computer to check train times before leaving.
example.zh: 我出門前用電腦查火車時間。

example.en: Each passenger must show a ticket before getting on the bus.
example.zh: 每位乘客上公車前都必須出示車票。

example.en: Avoid driving downtown during rush hour if you can.
example.zh: 可以的話，尖峰時段避免開車進市中心。

example.en: This bus route connects the airport and the city center.
example.zh: 這條公車路線連接機場與市中心。

example.en: The train fare will go up by five percent next month.
example.zh: 火車票價下個月會調漲百分之五。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。commuter = commute + -er，做這件事的人，像 teacher、worker
